data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Does the COVID-19 vaccine have bad side effects? ASSISTANT:

The COVID-19 vaccine has been shown to have few side effects and is generally well tolerated. In clinical trials, the most common side effects reported were mild and temporary, such as a sore arm from the injection or a headache.

Yes, most stores will accept the return of clothes that are in a re-sellable condition with a valid receipt.
